about: The Dex shows a species seen only as one of its forms as that form, until it sees the species itself (Paolo's decision of 2026-10-04; Pokedex_RecordMonSeen's DEX_SEEN_AS_FORM_ONLY, PokedexApp_ShownSpecies), and its FORMS page lists the forms seen (ov18_021E8254). Poke Maniac Larry's Galarian Slowpoke, fought in Union Cave against a scratch copy of Paolo's Falkner save (the Dex switched on by savedit, Raichu the first species it has seen, the player put by the cave's Route 33 mouth), is the first Slowpoke seen. The Dex is opened through the start menu and its grid walked from No. 0026 Raichu down ten rows and right three to No. 0079 Slowpoke: the grid's top screen, the INFO panel, draws the Galarian Slowpoke (gDiagDexShown, ov18_021F1BC8; the grid's icon is the Galarian one too, in the shot). Its FORMS page has one entry, the Galarian form in the gender it was seen in, Psychic alone (gDiagDexFormShown, gDiagDexFormTypes, type1 | type2 << 8, Psychic 14), and DOWN moves nowhere, no cry playing: the form is not listed twice. Its AREA page reads the Galarian species' own records, which name no place ("Area Unknown": no regional form is wild). The Dex closed, a wild Slowpoke forced on the next step (gDiagForceBattleSpecies), the field's RNG pinned again first so that its gender -- the FORMS list's entries -- does not hang on how many frames the steps before took, is seen and beaten; the Dex opens again on No. 0079, and the top screen now draws Slowpoke itself. FORMS opens on Slowpoke, Water and Psychic (0x0e0b), and DOWN moves to the Galarian Form after it, which cries as the Galarian species and shows Psychic alone; AREA from there is the Galarian species', and from FORMS' first entry Slowpoke's, which name its places (Slowpoke Well). Without the record the top screen draws Slowpoke from the start and FORMS opens on it.

lines: Poké Maniac Larry sent out Slowpoke!
